description: This file defines classes related to completing and managing responses asynchronously within the Orleans framework, including 'ResponseCompletionSource' which implements custom task source interfaces for handling responses with or without results.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource
classes.description: A fulfillable promise for 'Response' objects, implementing IResponseCompletionSource, IValueTaskSource<Response>, and IValueTaskSource for asynchronous response management.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource<TResult>
classes.description: A generic fulfillable promise for 'TResult' objects, implementing IResponseCompletionSource, IValueTaskSource<TResult>, and IValueTaskSource for asynchronous response management with typed results.

methods.name: AsValueTask
methods.description: Returns this response completion source as a ValueTask<Response> or ValueTask<TResult>.

methods.name: AsVoidValueTask
methods.description: Returns this response completion source as a non-result ValueTask.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the operation based on a token.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Registers a callback to be called upon completion.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the completion source for reuse.

methods.name: SetException
methods.description: Completes the operation with an exception.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Completes the operation with a Response or TResult.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes this instance with a Response or Response<TResult> or default.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result for a completed operation and resets the source if valid.
